(iii) In the Consultation Paper, there were two separate parameters for pre-paid and postpaid billing complaints namely ‘metering and billing accuracy –post paid’ and ‘metering and billing accuracy pre- paid’ due to which some of the stakeholders have linked them to M&B Regulation. To bring clarity to the objective of this parameter, the Authority has decided to change the name of the parameter to ‘Billing and charging complaints’ and merge both of them into a single parameter to simplify monitoring and reporting by the service provider. It is to be noted that billing or charging-related queries raised by customers are not to be counted towards complaints. 5.6.2 Resolution of billing/ charging complaints within four weeks (a) Input of Stakeholders Some of the stakeholders said that this parameter should be completely removed.
